description: This is a C source file implementing a Linux kernel driver for ATM (Asynchronous Transfer Mode) networking hardware, specifically for Lantiq hardware platforms. It contains core functions for managing ATM connections, descriptors, hardware initialization, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: ppe_ioctl
methods.description: Handles IOCTL commands for ATM device, providing MIB statistics and VCC info.

methods.name: ppe_open
methods.description: Opens an ATM VCC, allocates resources, and sets up hardware parameters.

methods.name: ppe_close
methods.description: Closes an ATM VCC, releases resources and bandwidth.

methods.name: ppe_send
methods.description: Sends an ATM cell or packet through the hardware.

methods.name: ppe_send_oam
methods.description: Sends an OAM cell for management purposes.

methods.name: ppe_change_qos
methods.description: Changes QoS parameters for an ATM VCC.

methods.name: atm_showtime_enter
methods.description: Enters 'showtime' mode, configuring hardware for active data transfer.

methods.name: atm_showtime_exit
methods.description: Exits 'showtime' mode, restoring hardware to idle state.

methods.name: ltq_atm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the ATM driver when the hardware device is detected.

methods.name: ltq_atm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the ATM device is removed.
